models.name: MiMo-V2.6-Pro-UltraSpeed

price_usd_per_million.scope: Official overseas pay-as-you-go uncached API tokens; USD per million. Excludes search fees, cache, reasoning volume. This tier does not support batch API.

notes: UltraSpeed is a separate serving tier of the open-weight Pro checkpoint, not a separate released checkpoint or independently measured benchmark model.

The underlying Pro weights are open, but the exact UltraSpeed hosted serving tier has no separately downloadable checkpoint. For local deployment choose Pro or Flash; UltraSpeed speed claims do not transfer to local serving.
Its advertised up-to-20x output speed is a vendor claim, not an end-to-end task latency guarantee. Do not copy Pro benchmark scores into an UltraSpeed measured-result row.
Official Chinese model page lists all four inputs; English page currently shows only text despite its omni-modal capability heading. Chinese page and API capability table are used here.
Official pricing: https://mimo.mi.com/docs/en-US/price/pay-as-you-go
